==English== ===Etymology=== Borrowed from {{bor|en|frm|condenser}}, from {{der|en|la|condēnsō}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/kənˈdɛns/}} * {{audio|en|En-us-condense.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛns|s=2}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[concentrate]] toward the [[essence]] by making more [[close]], [[compact]], or [[dense]], thereby [[decrease|decreasing]] [[size]] or [[volume]]. #: {{syn|en|thicken|simplify|reduce|q3=cooking|Thesaurus:compress}} #: {{ant|en|dilute}} #: {{ux|en|An abridged dictionary can be further '''condensed''' to pocket size.}} #: {{ux|en|Boiling off water '''condenses''' a thin sauce into a soupier mixture.}} #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=1|passage=In what shape they choose,
Dilated or '''condensed''', bright or obscure.|year=1873}} #* {{RQ:Motley Dutch Republic|passage=The secret course pursued both at Brussels and at Madrid may be '''condensed''' into the usual formula, dissimulation, procrastination, and again dissimulation.}} # {{lb|en|transitive|chemistry}} To transform from a [[gas]]eous state into a [[liquid]] state via [[condensation]]. # {{lb|en|intransitive|chemistry}} To be transformed from a [[gas]]eous state into a [[liquid]] state. #: {{ux|en|Water '''condenses''' on the window on cold days because of the warm air inside.}} ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|condensability|condensable|condensate|condenseness|condensery|condensible|condensin|decondense|polycondense|recondense |condensing locomotive|overcondense|underercondense}} ====Related terms==== {{col|en |condensate |condenser |condensation }} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|to concentrate toward the essence}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * German: * Greek: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Latin: * Russian: {{t+|ru|сгуща́ть|impf}}, {{t+|ru|сгусти́ть|pf}} * Spanish: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to transform from a gaseous state into a liquid state}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * German: * Interlingua: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|конденси́ровать|impf|pf}} * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Thai: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to be transformed from a gaseous state into a liquid state}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * German: * Icelandic: * Interlingua: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Māori: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|конденси́роваться|impf|pf}} * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Thai: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj}} # {{lb|en|archaic}} Condensed;
